## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and passing. For behavior changes, the full integration suite across **SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MariaDB** — not unit tests alone.
- [ ] Cross-engine parity considered — the change works on all four engines, or the description says why it's genuinely engine-specific.
- [ ] New `.cs` files carry the SSCL v2.0 copyright header; new `Schema/Scripts/*.sql` files carry the `--` equivalent.
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior changed — end-user docs, `README.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] CI is green.
